title: Encyclopaedia Britannica; or, A dictionary of arts, sciences, and miscellaneous literature - Fourth edition, Volume 6 Part 1, CHI-Conchology - EB.9
text: COMMODIANUS, GAZUS, a Christian author in the 4th century, who wrote more in Latin verife, entitled inflications, the moral of which is excellent, but the very extremely heavy. M. Davies published a fine edition of it in 1711, at the end of Minucius Fabis.
